newsitem.title: USA: ITT to sell North American aftermarket unit.
newsitem.headline: ITT to sell North American aftermarket unit.

text.p: ITT Automotive, a unit of ITT Industries Inc., said Tuesday it is selling its North American Aftermarket division to Echlin Inc. for undisclosed terms.
ITT is divesting non-core assets and refocusing operations on core hotels and gambling business to fend off a $6.5 billion hostile takeover bid by Hilton Hotels Corp.
The latest sale includes manufacturing and distribution centres in the United States.
The ITT Automotive division will operate as Aimco Products Inc., a division of Echlin's North American Aftermarket Operations. The unit's annual sales are about $140 million.
ITT, based in New York, said it will continue to own and operate its after-market unit in Europe.
Echlin, based in Branford, Conn., is a worldwide supplier of automotive products.
ITT's stock fell 50 cents to $59.375, and Echlin edged up 12.5 cents to $32.875 on the New York Stock Exchange in midafternoon.
